offer.text: The nights bite cold and these old bones feel every one. Would you bring your grandfather a proper bed to rest in? Wool and timber, that's all I ask.

accept.text: You're a good grandchild. I'll make space by the window.

decline.text: Ah, never mind an old soul's grumbling. Off you go.

in_progress.text: Still drafty in here. Any luck with that bed?

ready.text: A fine soft bed! I'll sleep like a babe tonight.

complete.text: Warm at last, thanks to you. You've a kind heart, child of my child.
